text: Why does a flute... sound so sad?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi opens his great poem, the Masnavi, with a crying flute.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Hearken to the reed-flute, how it complains, lamenting its banishment from its home.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The flute was cut from its reed bed. Its song... is the sound of missing home.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Like a student in a new city, far from family. Life looks fine... but something keeps calling.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He who abides far away from his home is ever longing for the day he shall return.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: But here's the catch... the reed only sings because it was cut... and hollowed.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your longing is not weakness. It is a compass.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action today: name one thing you miss... and take one small step toward it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What does your heart miss most? Tell me below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
